measured_facts_used_verbatim.settlement_grid_rule_frozen: HYPOTHESIS (frozen, to be evidenced): Binance USD(S)-M perpetual funding settlements for all three symbols occur at instants S on the 8h grid 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC. At a settlement, every open position is a compelled counterparty to the transfer: longs pay shorts when the funding rate is positive, shorts pay longs when negative. This rule is deterministic public venue mechanics; no price or outcome data enters the clock. Per the plan's fail-closed law, every in-window grid instant MUST be evidenced by the pulled settlement series before any scored use (see data_dependency); an unevidenced instant is dropped, never inferred.

The probe therefore evidences the grid only for 2026-03-29..2026-08-21 inside the panel window; the earlier window months are UNPROBED and remain hypothesis until the full-window pull.

measured_facts_used_verbatim.forbidden_conditioning: NO funding LEVEL enters the direction rule of any anchor/neighbour/shadow/placebo arm - the funding series enters this family ONLY as (i) settlement-instant evidence, (ii) a per-decision cash transfer booked for the ONE arm whose hold crosses a true snapshot (the placebo, see costs), and (iii) the direction of the declared FUNDJUMP-LEVEL decorrelation control arm, which exists precisely so D2 can measure that leakage separately. No OI consumed (oi_series_reduced.json is in the frozen set but NOT read by this proposal); no price/OI/funding LEVEL conditions anything; the observable is a bounded flow ratio in which the volume level cancels.

mechanism.forced_participant: The same paying-side holders, coerced in two stages: BEFORE the snapshot S they must flatten to dodge the transfer (deadline-bound, urgency-priced), and AFTER the payment has cleared their coercion switches to inventory - they still want the exposure they just abandoned and must restore it while the receivers' profit-taking joins the opposite side. The deadline that forces both stages is the published venue settlement schedule, not any endogenous market state.
mechanism.late_participant: Unhurried liquidity that re-quotes normally only after the re-entry wave has completed and the boundary dislocation has been absorbed.
mechanism.why_effect_exists: The coercion switches OFF exactly at S: the transfer is made, the dodging population's deadline is gone, and the boundary-crossing price dislocation their one-sided flow pushed to now lacks any willing holder - it is unwound by the dodgers' own re-entry and the receivers' profit-taking over the following hours. The observable is the boundary-crossing taker imbalance (the flow pushed by payment urgency on both sides of the print, [S-1h, S+1h)); the reaction is its POST-settlement reversal, entered only after the boundary bar has fully closed and the payment is booked history.
when_it_must_fail: If the boundary-crossing imbalance is informative continuation rather than coerced over-extension, the post-settlement fade loses: anchor after-cost expectancy <= 0 (F4).
If re-entry is gradual and diffuse (no measurable reversal at H1 granularity over the following 3 hours), the fade earns nothing and loses costs (F4).

If the reversal is generic H1 imbalance reversal with no settlement content, the SHIFTMINUS2H placebo (same rule shape at an off-grid hour) reproduces the anchor at same-sign >= 0.5x (F1) - the XSECT-REVERSAL / Bollinger-RSI neighbourhood death.
If the book is the bare 3x/day clock, the always-long clock shadow out-earns the anchor or correlates > 0.20 with it (F2).

If the anchor's returns are the funding carry form in disguise, the in-family FUNDJUMP-LEVEL control reproduces it or D2's external funding-LEVEL proxy vetoes it at pooled |rho| > 0.20 (F3) - the named FUNDJUMP death (V17, rho 0.2439).
If the 00:00 UTC leg is secretly the dead UTC-day-boundary exposure (CLOSE-DISPLACE-FADE / RUNPERSIST ancestry), D2's day-boundary shadows veto it (F3).

observable_pinned.definition: cross(symbol, S) = (SUM buy_quote - SUM sell_quote) / (SUM quote_total) over the two closed bars B-1..B = [S-1h, S+1h), the boundary-crossing window ending at S-1h plus the settlement bar itself, a bounded net-pressure ratio in [-1, +1] fully point-in-time at the decision instant (close of bar B = S+1h); the volume level cancels in the ratio
observable_pinned.instant_source: deterministic 8h funding-settlement grid 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC (hypothesis verified against the full-window settlement pull at P2/D2 per data_dependency; grid instants map to hour bars, tolerant of the observed boundary+1ms funding_time quirk)

clock.bar: H1 UTC from the frozen S4 panels, bar hour_utc=T covers [T, T+1h)
clock.boundary_bar: B(S) = the bar whose open equals the settlement instant S (e.g. S=08:00:00Z -> bar 'dateT08'); the settlement instant is the OPEN boundary of B; the payment clears at S inside bar B
clock.decision: at the CLOSE of bar B = S+1h, the first bar close at which the boundary-crossing window is fully point-in-time AND the payment is booked history - entry is deliberately AFTER the settlement so the trade tests post-settlement repricing only; the anchor is FLAT at every settlement snapshot and books NO transfer (next snapshot is S+8h, after exit)
clock.exit_boundary: at the CLOSE of bar B+3 = S+4h (anchor H=3: e.g. 08:00 boundary -> exit 12:00 UTC); no settlement falls inside the hold
clock.instant_alignment: pure UTC arithmetic on the frozen H1 index; the 8h grid has no DST and no calendar dependence (every day, weekends included - crypto trades continuously and settles continuously)

warmup.rule: a grid instant S is eligible only if every bar referenced by any arm of this family (deepest backward = placebo feature bar B'-1 = S-3h; deepest forward = anchor exit B+3 = S+4h) exists inside the frozen panel bounds AND S is evidenced by the pulled settlement series; no minimum-history convention beyond construction (features need 2 bars)
warmup.coverage: first eligible grid instant = 2025-08-22T08:00Z (the 2025-08-22T00:00Z instant needs the 2025-08-21T23 feature bar, pre-panel - INELIGIBLE_WARMUP, not an outcome-driven drop); last instant 2026-08-21T16:00Z needs exit bar close 20:00 - exists; therefore 1,094 eligible instants/symbol before settlement-evidence filtering (evidence filter applied fail-closed at P2/D2; unevidenced instants recorded UNFUNDED_SKIP_NO_SETTLEMENT, counted, never silently dropped)
warmup.signal_history: none required beyond the boundary-crossing window itself (no threshold fitting exists - sign is the only operator)

columns_from_panel.buy_quote: USD notional of buy-taker flow in bar
columns_from_panel.sell_quote: USD notional of sell-taker flow in bar
columns_from_panel.last_price: last traded price in bar, used as the bar-close fill price

features_lags.lag_structure: windowed feature at lags -1..0 relative to the boundary bar B (anchor and all arms); decision at lag 0 close (S+1h); exit at lag +3 close (anchor H=3) / +1 close (neighbour H=1); volume enters only as a bounded ratio denominator; no volume LEVEL is used anywhere; no other lags, no rolling windows, no fitted parameters

entry_exit_fills.direction: d = -sign(cross) = -sign((SUM buy_quote - SUM sell_quote)/SUM quote_total) over bars B-1..B (the fade of the boundary-crossing forced flow); tie (numerator exactly 0) -> decision recorded UNFUNDED_SKIP (counted, not silently dropped)
entry_exit_fills.entry: at close of bar B (S+1h, AFTER the payment), fill price = last_price of bar B, unit notional 1.0 per decision per symbol, no leverage parameter, no sizing conditioning
entry_exit_fills.exit: at close of bar B+3 (S+4h), fill price = last_price of bar B+3; no stop, no early exit; no settlement snapshot falls inside the hold, so no transfer is booked (except the placebo arm, disclosed in its rule)
entry_exit_fills.fills_per_funded_decision: 2 (entry + exit), each charged cost exactly once (L-V14-0); a settlement transfer, where a hold crosses a snapshot, is a cash exchange - NOT a fill and NOT charged taker cost

costs.authority: measured taker + spread schedule at stress tier 2.0 as PRIMARY (Q-2/Q-8), inherited from the V17 scored-driver kernel adoption; cost exactly once per fill
costs.invention_disclaimer: NO cost constant is stated or invented in this proposal; the measured tier numbers come from the kernel's measured schedule at execution time. Measured beats stated everywhere.
costs.funding_transfer_booking: uniform booking law for the family: any arm whose position is open at a grid instant S books transfer = -d * rate(S) per unit notional at S (long d=+1 pays rate>0, short receives), rate taken VERBATIM from the pulled settlement series. The anchor/neighbour/shadow/level-control holds ([S+1h, S+4h) or shorter) cross NO snapshot and book nothing; the SHIFTMINUS2H placebo hold ([S-1h, S+2h)) crosses the true snapshot S and books it - disclosed there. If the series cannot be pulled, the placebo's transfer is NOT assumed zero - that arm is BLOCKED_DATA (zero fabrication).

anchor.rule: direction = -sign(cross over B-1..B); entry close of B (S+1h); exit close of B+3 (S+4h); H = 3 bars; no transfer booked
anchor.decisions: 1,094 grid instants x 3 symbols = 3,282 funded decisions per arm (minus exact-tie and no-evidence skips, both counted)

neighbour.rule: identical direction rule, decision grid and entry; exit at close of B+1 (S+2h); H = 1 bar; no transfer booked
neighbour.mechanism_support: if the post-payment unwind is genuinely coerced re-entry, the repricing should be front-loaded - the first post-boundary hour must retain the sign with graceful decay; a horizon cliff or sign flip at H=1 contradicts the mechanism (different parameterization, same mechanism)

causal_placebo_control.rule: sham boundary clock: the whole rule shifted -2h off-grid, S' = S-2h (grid {22:00, 06:00, 14:00} UTC): feature B'-1..B' = [S-3h, S-1h), entry close of B' (S-1h), exit close of B'+3 (S+2h), H = 3; its hold [S-1h, S+2h) crosses the TRUE settlement S, so it books the S transfer under the uniform booking law - the only arm of this family that does
causal_placebo_control.identifiability: -2h is chosen over +1h/+2h because a +2h shift places the sham FEATURE window [S+1h, S+3h) inside the anchor's HOLD window [S+1h, S+4h) - a lagged twin of the anchor on the same settlement flow, which would self-subsume (the SFV12-A5-H1 0.9923 failure), not a placebo. The -2h sham fades PRE-boundary imbalance entered PRE-boundary - economically different from the anchor (which fades boundary-crossing flow entered after the payment cleared): if the reversal needs the payment to have happened, fading pre-boundary flow while still holding INTO the snapshot must not reproduce it. The sham lands on real off-grid hours with real microstructure; it CAN move the signal (Q-11 satisfied; a control that cannot move the signal would be INVALID NULL).
causal_placebo_control.decisions: 1,094 sham instants x 3 symbols = 3,282 decisions; everything else identical to anchor (fade of the sham boundary-crossing window, H = 3, true-S transfer booked)

clock_only_shadow.rule: identical decision grid and holds (entry close of B, exit close of B+3), costs; direction = +1 at EVERY decision (pure 3x/day 8h-grid clock exposure carrying zero panel information); holds cross no snapshot, no transfer booked
clock_only_shadow.purpose: isolates what the bare deterministic settlement clock yields in the post-boundary window (including its 00:00 day-boundary leg); if the anchor is subsumed by this exposure the mechanism claim is empty

fundjump_level_decorrelation_control.rule: identical decision grid, holds and costs as the anchor; direction = -sign(rate(S)) from the pulled series (short when longs pay, long when shorts pay - the classic funding-LEVEL carry form that killed FUNDJUMP at rho 0.2439); holds cross no snapshot, no transfer booked
fundjump_level_decorrelation_control.purpose_and_status: a deliberately level-formed signal ON THE SAME CLOCK so D2 can measure the anchor's decorrelation from the level form separately from the external proxy panel; this arm is the known-dead ancestry form rendered explicit - it is NOT promotable under any outcome and exists only for measurement

ancestry_defense: FUNDJUMP (V17) was killed because its announced-change event book still carried the funding LEVEL (pooled |rho| 0.2439 vs the carry proxy): P2's direction is the sign of a bounded boundary-crossing taker-flow ratio computed purely from the frozen panels - the level enters NO direction rule; the level form exists only in the declared CTL-FUNDLEVEL arm (unpromotable by construction); F3 measures exactly this leakage in-family and D2 measures it against the external FUNDJUMP shadow. CARRY-1D/3D/7D (V6) and OITD (V13) are dead rate/OI term-structure and carry forms: P2 consumes no rate term structure and no OI (oi_series_reduced.json frozen but NOT read). CLOSE-DISPLACE-FADE and RUNPERSIST (V16) are dead endogenous UTC-day-boundary forms: only 1 of the 3 daily boundary legs touches 00:00 UTC, the observable is a bounded side-ratio (not displacement/persistence), and the always-long SHADOW-CLOCK8HGRID plus D2's day-boundary shadows are the designed kills if day-boundary exposure leaks. WKNDLIQ (V17) died as a calendar-conditioned liquidity LEVEL (rho 0.5628 vs dvol proxies): the volume level cancels in P2's ratio denominator, settlements occur every single day (weekends included - no weekday conditioning exists), and the dvol proxies remain P2's named F3 kill. ATTN-PHASE (V17) was a daily US-session phase on SOL: P2 has no session conditioning and treats all three boundary hours (00/08/16) symmetrically in one frozen grid. The generic-imbalance-reversal interpretation (the XSECT-REVERSAL / H-XSECT-REVERSAL-v2 / Bollinger-RSI neighbourhood) is exactly what the SHIFTMINUS2H sham and the clock-only shadow are built to falsify: if two-bar imbalance reversal is generic, an off-grid hour reproduces it. TICKET-BREADTH (V17) died on the tsmom proxy: the full proxy panel incl. tsmom28 is measured at D2. The CRYPTO-NG1 A5 expiry-clock forms (quarterly delivery / monthly options last-Friday 08:00 UTC) are a different clock (4-8 sparse expiry instants/year vs 1,095 settlement instants/year) with a different forced population (delivery holders and options dealers vs funding payers); this lane is blind to their outcomes by design and D2 measures pooled |rho| vs whatever ng1 shapes the inventory holds.
distinctness_vs_sibling: P2's information source is the boundary-CROSSING taker flow over [S-1h, S+1h) (the payment-urgency flow on both sides of the print) with a REVERSAL reaction entered only AFTER the payment has cleared (S+1h) and held to S+4h; the anchor is FLAT at every settlement snapshot and books no transfer. CNG2-A5-P1 uses the PRE-boundary terminal pressure over [S-4h, S-1h) with a CONTINUATION reaction that enters before the boundary and holds THROUGH the payment (transfer booked). Different information-source layer, opposite reaction form, different entry side of the boundary, disjoint hold windows - P2 enters exactly where P1 exits. Cross-proposal collapse is tested by frozen rule F5.

rules.consequence: FALSIFIED - the payment-clearing event adds nothing beyond generic two-bar imbalance reversal at off-grid hours (falsification-by-control cluster semantics)

rules.consequence: FALSIFIED / D2 VETO recorded with margin (P-2); the named shadows are the funding-LEVEL carry proxy (the FUNDJUMP killer), the dvol_level_log/dvol_shock proxies (WKNDLIQ's killers), the day-boundary shadows (CLOSE-DISPLACE-FADE/RUNPERSIST) and tsmom28 (TICKET-BREADTH)

rules.consequence: DEAD (mechanical reject); negative-first verdict stands, no re-parameterization

rules.condition: pooled |rho| between CNG2-A5-P2-ANCHOR and CNG2-A5-P1-ANCHOR per-decision return series (daily-aggregated projection, D2 measurement on both declared representations) > 0.20
rules.consequence: the two proposals are ONE bet; only the stronger-evidenced mechanism advances to selection, the other is withdrawn - never both scored

expected_failure_interpretation: If F1 fires, fading two-bar imbalance works as well at off-grid hours with no payment inside the observable window - the settlement event carries no incremental information and the re-entry-unwind mechanism is dead on this substrate; it must not be re-clocked to other grids (4h/1h funding intervals would be a new preregistered hypothesis, never a rescue). If F3 fires in-family, P2 was the carry/level form in disguise - exactly the FUNDJUMP death (0.2439) this lane was mandated to pre-disclose, and an honest kill. If F2 fires, the always-long 3x/day book subsumes the anchor: calendar without flow information. If F4 fires with controls coherent (anchor loses, sham/shadow/level also lose), it is a plain negative: either dodgers' re-entry is too gradual to register at H1 granularity, or the reversal is smaller than measured tier-2.0 costs - one more instance of boundary-crossing imbalance being informative continuation rather than coerced over-extension. Any of these outcomes feeds CRYPTO_NG2_REJECT_ALL, which the plan registers as a successful research run.
